reason: A proposes the more physically credible intervention: an aluminide coating can form a slow-growing alumina barrier, whereas B extrapolates unsupported CrTaO₄ behavior from compositionally different, lower-Ti alloys and assumes an implausibly durable 100 nm Cr reservoir at 1000 °C for 100 h. A still needs cited support and quantitative acceptance criteria, but its controlled comparison and mechanical-property checks make it the stronger proposal.
